benefit_orientation: positive values always favor the candidate after metric direction normalization

primary_metric_states.PROMISING: lower confidence bound is at or above the predeclared minimum material improvement
primary_metric_states.TOO_SMALL: interval excludes unacceptable harm but its upper bound is below the minimum material improvement
primary_metric_states.HARMFUL: upper confidence bound is below the negative maximum tolerable harm
primary_metric_states.AMBIGUOUS: interval overlaps a material benefit or harm boundary
primary_metric_states.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: the denominator/exposure is zero or otherwise not estimable

guardrail_metric_states.SAFE: lower confidence bound is at or above the negative maximum tolerable harm
guardrail_metric_states.HARMFUL: upper confidence bound is below the negative maximum tolerable harm
guardrail_metric_states.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: the denominator/exposure is zero or otherwise not estimable

CLEAR_REJECT: or every primary metric is TOO_SMALL
PROMOTE_TO_FULL: and every guardrail metric is SAFE
AMBIGUOUS: all remaining cases, including insufficient evidence
